digest.component_or_area: gate workflow error recording (plan-review, code-review, completion gates)
propositions: Infrastructure exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at plan-review and code-review gates must emit an additive gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR while preserving the existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdict return.
Infrastructure exceptions at the completion gate must emit a gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR and then re-raise the exception to preserve the fail-closed contract.
The gate_error_v1 schema must not route through reconcile_verdict so the ERROR verdict is not coerced to FAIL, and existing verdict readers must skip gate_error_v1 records due to schema guards.
Domain-level BLOCK/FAIL exceptions (non-infrastructure) must not generate ERROR sidecar records.

build_error_payload(gate, cause, evidence_ref) must produce {schema:"gate_error_v1", verdict:"ERROR", gate:..., error:{cause,evidence_ref}} and be written to existing event types (REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT) without introducing new event types.
